messages.text:
Please add a Tournament mode for 4 or 8 players sharing one device. A Tournament button next to New Game opens it. Players choose 4 or 8 with a Players select, type names into inputs labelled Player 1 to Player 8, and press Start tournament. It's a knockout: in each match both players play the same deal, one after the other, and fewer moves wins. Show whose turn it is as "Now playing: NAME". A Start turn button begins each player's game. When a game ends a Next turn button appears, and when a match ends a Next match button appears. A Leave tournament button stops it early. Show the bracket with each match's players, their moves and time, and its winner, and "Champion: NAME" at the end with a Back to game button. Finished tournaments stay in a Past tournaments list on the Tournament screen after reload. Every Tournament screen has an Export tournament button that puts JSON in a Tournament JSON box, and a Load tournament button that reads that box back. Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

## Implemented

Added Tournament mode with 4 or 8 players, the documented knockout pairings, and one deal per match that both players replay. The bracket shows players, moves, time, and winners; players take turns through the match, and the winner advances to the champion screen.

Tournament setup, play, bracket, history, and JSON exchange are implemented in [Tournament.tsx](/work/src/game/tournament/Tournament.tsx), [rules.ts](/work/src/game/tournament/rules.ts), [format.ts](/work/src/game/tournament/format.ts), and [storage.ts](/work/src/game/tournament/storage.ts). Finished tournaments persist in Past tournaments. Export and load handle setup drafts and tournament events, with confirmation before replacing an unfinished tournament. Updated the project README and linked requirements.

**Verification:** 152 unit tests passed; typecheck, production build, all 3 tournament browser tests, and targeted Prettier checks passed. The repository-wide format check still flags Markdown formatting across 219 files, including untouched files.
